# IRIS - Sapienza University of Rome Research Repository

> > IRIS is the institutional research repository of Sapienza University of Rome, hosting peer-reviewed publications, research outputs, and academic works across multiple disciplines including finance, materials science, and risk management.

IRIS (Institutional Research Information System) serves as Sapienza University of Rome's central repository for documenting and disseminating scholarly research. The platform provides access to research outputs spanning financial modeling, polymer chemistry, insurance regulation compliance, and crisis forecasting methodologies.

## Key Topics

- Sapienza University of Rome
- IRIS Repository

## Financial Risk & Crisis Forecasting

- [RecessionRisk+: A Novel Recession Risk Model with Applications to the Solvency II Framework and Recession Crises Forecasting](https://iris.uniroma1.it/handle/11573/1728823): Advanced recession risk model for financial forecasting, Solvency II compliance, and crisis prediction in insurance and financial sectors

## Materials Science & Pharmaceutical Research

- [Synthesis and characterization of a novel amphiphilic polyacrylate-cholesterol derivative as promising material for pharmaceutical and cosmetic applications](https://iris.uniroma1.it/handle/11573/1664466): Novel polymer synthesis combining polyacrylate and cholesterol for pharmaceutical and cosmetic material applications
